meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 装上后,当你请它做发布前审查,它会找出自上次发布以来的代码改动并分组;派出至多 10 个智能体逐组细查,另用 5 个做整体审查,最后 1 个总评审给出意见。产出包含能否发布、建议版本号、破坏性变更、变更日志草稿、部署风险。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做发布前审查时触发,例如 'pre-publish review'、'release review'、'ready to publish?' 等表达;普通发布请求不会触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次发布前审查,看看能不能发版。
say.note: 会启动检测改动并运行全部审查。

say.text: 这些改动有没有破坏性变更?适合发布吗?
say.note: 重点检查破坏性变更,并给出版本建议。

say.text: 发布前检查一下,当前版本安全吗?
say.note: 会按三层流程完整过一遍再答复。

howto.what_en: Loaded, when you ask for a pre-publish review, it finds and groups changes since last release, spawns up to 10 agents for per-change deep dives, 5 for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Outputs: readiness, version bump, breaking changes, changelog, deployment risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'release review', 'ready to publish?'). A normal publish/release request must not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review to see if I can release.
say_en.note: Triggers change detection and full review.

say_en.text: Do these changes break anything? Ready to publish?
say_en.note: Checks breaking changes and gives version advice.

say_en.text: Is it safe to publish the current version?
say_en.note: Runs the complete multi-agent release gate.
